title: Unit Testing Metrics
description: Schema for the 'Unit Testing' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: TEST-1: count of shared mutable state issues and test interdependencies
TEST-2: count of logic-in-tests, missing phases, multiple behaviors, sleep-waiting, and multi-suite-per-file issues
TEST-3: count of non-descriptive test names and naming convention violations
TEST-4: count of over-mocking, brittle verification, and testing-mock-logic issues
TEST-5: count of repeated inline SUT construction across 2+ test methods
TEST-6: count of XCTest usage in non-UI test files where Swift Testing should be used instead
